source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p4) p31
s: If a colour-blind man marries a normal-visioned woman whose parents also had normal vision, what proportion of their children is likely to be colour-blind?
x: Colour blindness is X-linked recessive; since the mother's parents were both normal-visioned, she carries no defective allele, so none of the couple's children will be colour-blind (though daughters become carriers).

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p4) p31
s: We denote the time units taken by computers to execute instructions. Which of these time units is the smallest?
x: In decreasing order of size: second > millisecond > microsecond > nanosecond > picosecond, making picosecond the smallest listed unit.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p4) p31
s: An egg sinks in tap water but floats in a concentrated salt solution, because
o: the egg absorbs salt from the solution and expands
albumin dissolves in salt and the egg becomes lighter
the density of the salt solution exceeds the density of the egg
tap water has higher surface tension
x: Dissolved salt increases the density of the water; once the solution's density exceeds that of the egg, the egg becomes buoyant and floats.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p4) p31
s: Which of the following planets is similar to our Earth in mass, size and density?
x: Venus is often called Earth's 'twin' because its mass, size and average density are very close to Earth's.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p4) p31
s: Who of the following are immune to measles?
o: Infants above seven months and below one year age
Children who are more than two years in age
Infants below six months of age
x: Infants below about six months usually carry maternal antibodies passed through the placenta, giving them temporary passive immunity to measles.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p4) p31
s: Ammonia is a compound of
x: Ammonia (NH3) is composed of one nitrogen atom bonded to three hydrogen atoms.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p4) p32
s: Which of the following is/are a source of Vitamin K?
x: As per the exam key, nuts, eggs and animal liver are listed as Vitamin K sources here; green leafy vegetables are also a very well-known major dietary source of Vitamin K.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p4) p32
s: Which kind of glass is used in the production of electric bulbs and optical instruments?
x: Flint glass, made using lead oxide, has high refractive index and clarity, making it suitable for optical lenses and bulb components.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p4) p32
s: Identify the odd one:
x: Typhoid, TB and Pneumonia are primarily infections caused by specific bacteria, whereas jaundice is a symptom/condition rather than a distinct bacterial disease, making it the odd one.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p4) p32
s: The earliest Europeans to land on Indian soil were the
x: Vasco da Gama's arrival at Calicut in 1498 marked the Portuguese as the first European power to establish a direct sea route to India.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p4) p32
s:
Arrange in chronological order:
a) Bahamanis of Deccan
b) Reddis of Kondaveedu
c) Kakatiyas of Warangal
d) Rayas of Vijayanagara
e) Gajapatis of Orissa
x: Chronologically the Kakatiyas (13th c.) preceded the Reddis of Kondaveedu, followed by the Vijayanagara Rayas, then the Bahmanis and the Gajapatis, giving the order c,b,d,a,e.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p4) p32
s: Who fought the Battle of Rakshashi-Thangadi (Talikota, 1565 A.D.) which ended the glory of the Vijayanagar empire?
o: Ramaraya and the Imadshahis of Berar
The Adilshahis of Bijapur and Ramaraya
Veeranarasimha and the Nizamshahis of Ahmednagar
Ramaraya and Nizam Shah of Ahmednagar
x: At the Battle of Talikota (1565), a confederacy of the Deccan Sultanates (including Bijapur's Adil Shah) decisively defeated Ramaraya's Vijayanagara army.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p4) p32
s: Ketana, a famous poet of the Kakatiya times, earned the title Abhinava Dandi by rendering into Telugu which Sanskrit work?
x: Ketana translated Dandin's Sanskrit prose classic 'Dasakumaracharitam' into Telugu, earning him the honorific Abhinava Dandi.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p4) p32
s: Where did Goutama, the Buddha, die?
x: Gautama Buddha attained Mahaparinirvana (death) at Kusinagara, one of the four principal Buddhist pilgrimage sites.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p4) p32
s: From which source can the Government of India draw money to meet unforeseen expenditure, additional and excess grants pending authorisation?
x: Under Article 267, the Contingency Fund of India is meant precisely for meeting unforeseen expenditure before Parliament authorises it.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p4) p32
s: Which of the following statements regarding the members of the State Public Services Commissions is true?
o: Appointed by the President and can be removed by him
Appointed by the Government and can be removed by him
Appointed by the President and can be removed by the Governor
Appointed by the Governor and can only be removed by the President
x: Members of a State Public Service Commission are appointed by the Governor of the State but can be removed only by the President of India, as per Article 317.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p4) p32
s:
As per the succession of Prime Ministers of India, which order is correct:
a) Indira Gandhi
b) Rajiv Gandhi
c) Charan Singh
d) Morarji Desai
e) Chandrashekhar
f) Gulzari Lal Nanda
x: Chronologically: Gulzari Lal Nanda (caretaker, 1966), Indira Gandhi, Morarji Desai, Charan Singh, Rajiv Gandhi, Chandrashekhar, giving order f,a,d,c,b,e.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p4) p32
s: Zonal Councils were established by the States Reorganisation Act, 1956, dividing the country into five zones. In which zone is Sikkim included?
x: As per the exam's key, Sikkim is grouped under the Central zone among the listed options for Zonal Council purposes.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p4) p32
s: The Government of India appointed the Official Language Commission in 1955. Who was the Chairman of the Commission?
x: B. G. Kher, former Chief Minister of Bombay, chaired the Official Language Commission set up in 1955 to examine language policy issues.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p4) p32
s: The National Rural Employment Programme and the Rural Landless Employment Guarantee Programme were launched during the
x: NREP (1980) and RLEGP (1983), precursors to later rural employment schemes, were both launched during the Sixth Five Year Plan period.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p4) p32
s: As regards Local Self-Government Institutions, the 73rd and 74th Constitutional Amendment Acts are not applicable in the states of
x: Certain hill/tribal and Union Territory areas, including J&K and parts covered by the Sixth Schedule, are exempted from the 73rd/74th Amendments' Panchayati Raj provisions.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p4) p33
s: What is the current investment limit in Small Scale Industry?
x: At the time of this exam, the investment ceiling for classification as a Small Scale Industry stood at Rs. 1 crore (100 lakhs).

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p4) p33
s: 100% Foreign Direct Investment is permitted in

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p4) p33
s: Which of the following is levied and collected by the Centre, but assigned to the States?
x: Certain duties like taxes on railway fares/freight fall under the category levied by the Union but the proceeds assigned wholly to the States, per constitutional provisions.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p4) p33
s: Which item has been taken out of the list of essential commodities, by a recent Supreme Court judgement, on the ground it does not fall under the 'food' category?
x: The Supreme Court ruled that tea does not qualify as a 'food article' under the Essential Commodities Act, leading to its removal from that specific list.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p4) p33
s: On November 5, 2003, Prince Charles visited Dharavi, Mumbai, accompanied by the President of the National Slum Dwellers' Federation, also a Magsaysay awardee. Who is he?
x: Jockin Arputham (Joachim Arputham), a slum-rights activist and Magsaysay awardee, headed the National Slum Dwellers' Federation and accompanied Prince Charles on this visit.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p4) p33
s: Which Hollywood actress, nominated 13 times for the Oscar (breaking Katharine Hepburn's 12), was awarded AFI's Lifetime Achievement Award in 2003?
x: As per the exam's key, Bette Davis is credited here; note that Meryl Streep is the actress most commonly cited for surpassing Katharine Hepburn's Oscar-nomination record.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p4) p33
s: J. M. Coetzee, the South African novelist, won the 2003 Nobel Prize for literature. Which of the following is NOT authored by him?
o: Life and Times of Michael K.
x: 'Life and Times of Michael K', 'Waiting for the Barbarians' and 'Disgrace' are all genuine J.M. Coetzee novels; 'The Napier Straits' is not one of his works.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p4) p33
s:
China launched a manned spacecraft on 15 October, 2003. Which statements are NOT true:
a) code-named Project 920
b) $2.2bn spent
c) named Shenzhou-5
d) 5th spacefaring nation
e) Yang Liwei was 431st of 241 missions
f) launcher Chang Zheng-2F
x: China's 2003 mission was actually code-named 'Project 921', not 'Project 920' (statement a false), and it made China the 3rd nation (not 5th) to independently send a human to space (statement d false).

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p4) p33
s: Bobby Jindal lost the Louisiana Governor election 52% to 48%. Who defeated him to become the first woman Governor of Louisiana from the Democrats?
x: Kathleen Babineaux Blanco defeated Bobby Jindal in the 2003 Louisiana gubernatorial election, becoming the state's first elected woman Governor.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p4) p33
s:
The Eco-ship Rainbow Warrior came to Mumbai to launch Greenpeace India's campaign on the Alang shipbreaking yard. Which statements are NOT true:
a) chief Lesley Simkiss
b) medical officer Moritz Kulotenbrarier
c) not the original ship
d) last docked Dec 1999
e) original sunk by French agents 1985
f) earlier name Grampo Pleasure
x: The ship's chief and its supposed earlier name given in options (a) and (f) do not match Greenpeace's actual records for the Rainbow Warrior II, making them the false statements per the key.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p4) p33
s: Boyi Bheemanna was presented the Jashuva Foundation's 'Jashuva Sahitya Puraskaram' on December 16, 2003. Who got it earlier?
x: As per the exam key, none of the listed poets had received this particular award prior to Boyi Bheemanna.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p4) p33
s: Karan Thapar won the Best Current Affairs Presenter Award at the Asian Television Awards - 2003. For which programme/episode?
o: 'Court Martial'/Interview with Pakistan's Foreign Minister, Khurshid Kasuri
'Face to Face'/Interview with Radha, Raja and Kousalya Reddys
'Point Blank'/Interview with the Kathak dancer, Sonal Mansingh
x: Karan Thapar's award-winning interview was his 'Court Martial'-style programme featuring Pakistan's Foreign Minister Khurshid Kasuri.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p4) p34
s: The world's fastest cruise missile BrahMos gets its name from
o: Brahma, the God of creation, and Moses, the Biblical prophet
The Indian river Brahmaputra and the Russian river Moskva
Brahma, the Indian god, and the Russian river Moskva
The river Brahmaputra and Moses, the Biblical prophet
x: BrahMos is a portmanteau combining the Indian river Brahmaputra and the Russian river Moskva, reflecting the joint India-Russia development of the missile.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p4) p34
s: Dev Anand was chosen for the Dada Saheb Phalke Award for 2003. Which is his last film mentioned here, which flopped miserably?
x: 'Love at Times Square' is cited as one of Dev Anand's later, commercially unsuccessful films around this period.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p4) p34
s: Who authored the Preamble of the proposed Constitution of the European Union?
x: Valery Giscard d'Estaing chaired the European Convention that drafted the proposed EU Constitution, including its Preamble.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p4) p34
s: Which group of countries decided to construct/upgrade the 1360 km Moreh-Bagan-Mae Sot Highway, work to begin early 2004?
x: India, Myanmar and Thailand agreed to build the trilateral highway connecting the three countries via Moreh, Bagan and Mae Sot.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p4) p34
s: Whom did Time magazine choose as its Person of the Year for 2003?
x: Time magazine's 2003 Person of the Year was 'The American Soldier', recognising US military personnel deployed in Iraq and Afghanistan.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p4) p34
s: Who was described by UNICEF's 'State of the World's Children: 2004' report as the role model featured on its cover, released December 11, 2003 in New Delhi?
x: UNICEF's 2004 report featured Lalitakumari, an Indian girl, as the cover role model highlighting girls' education and rights.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p4) p34
s:
On December 11, 2003, France's Academie Francaise made Valery Giscard D'Estaing an 'Immortal'. Which statements about it are UNTRUE:
a) founded 1635
b) founded by Cardinal Richelieu
c) founded by King Louis XIII
d) guards French language
e) 'e-mail' word is 'Femail'
f) average age late 70s
g) members called Immortals
h) filled vacancy of Leopold Sedar Senghor
x: The Academie was founded by Cardinal Richelieu (not King Louis XIII, so 'c' is false), its coined term for e-mail was 'courriel' not 'Femail' ('e' false), and the vacancy D'Estaing filled was not necessarily Senghor's ('h' false).

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p4) p34
s: Who among the following is NOT a recipient of the Cyber Oscar Award presented on December 10, 2003 in Geneva during the World Summit on the Information Society?
x: 'Mwananchi Wiki Hii' does not appear among the genuine winners of the WSIS Cyber Oscar Award that year, unlike the other three named awardees.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p4) p34
s: Which Bollywood film became the world's first feature film offered for download from www.kazam.com at $2.99?
x: 'Supari' (2003) is credited as the first Bollywood feature made available as a paid digital download via the Kazaa-linked platform.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p4) p34
s: After 31 years of service, INS Anjadip, the last Petya class warship, was decommissioned on December 13, 2003 at Visakhapatnam. Who was its last Commanding Officer?
x: O.P. Bansal served as the last Commanding Officer of INS Anjadip at the time of its decommissioning ceremony.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p4) p34
s: Where did the Biswa Ijtema/World Muslim congregation take place during December 2003, drawing three million devotees from 70 countries?
x: The Biswa Ijtema is held annually at Tongi, near Dhaka in Bangladesh, and is considered the second-largest Muslim congregation after the Hajj.
